extraction_notes: The supplied PDF identifies MMBT2222A as an NPN transistor from JIANGSU CHANGJIANG ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.; the output MPN preserves the exact catalog target MMBT2222A 1P.
Curve points are manual digitizations at visible axis and grid positions from the Typical Characteristics plots; no points were interpolated between sampled positions.

The electrical table provides hFE limits at IC = 0.1 mA, 150 mA, and 500 mA, two VCE(sat)/VBE(sat) maximum pairs, fT minimum, and V(BR)CEO minimum. Electrical characteristics are specified at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted, with starred rows subject to the pulse-test footnote.
Cobo and Cibo are not tabulated in the supplied PDF and were extracted as digitized typical values from the plotted capacitance curves at the stated reverse biases.

The maximum-ratings table also gives VCBO = 75 V, VEBO = 6 V, continuous IC = 0.6 A, PC = 0.3 W, RthetaJA = 417 degC/W, TJ = 150 degC, and Tstg = -55 to 150 degC; the strict BJT extraction schema has no fields for these additional limits.
